definitions.explanation: A Japanese chain of stores selling furniture, bedding, kitchenware and other household goods at low prices. Founded in Sapporo, it now has stores all over Japan.

examples.japanese: ニトリ⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦カーテン→カーテン：01342_kaaten⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{買|か}った→買う：00489_kau⟧。

examples.english: I'm going to Nitori before the move.

examples.japanese: ⟦{一人暮|ひとりぐ}らし→一人暮らし：03142_hitorigurashi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{始|はじ}めるとき、⟦{家具|かぐ}→家具：12314_kagu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦ほとんど→ほとんど：00847_hotondo⟧ニトリでそろえた。
examples.english: When I started living alone, I got almost all my furniture at Nitori.

notes:
A familiar name for anyone setting up a home in Japan, especially students and people living alone for the first time. Its advertising slogan, お、ねだん⟦{以上|いじょう}→以上：01308_ijou⟧。("Oh, more than the price"), is widely known.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- ニトリ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{家具|かぐ}→家具：12314_kagu⟧: Nitori furniture
- ニトリでそろえる: to get (everything) at Nitori

SIMILAR WORDS:
- イケア: IKEA, also popular in Japan
- ⟦ホームセンター→ホームセンター：11152_hoomusentaa⟧: a home-improvement store
